links.outcome: Presence of hallucinated or fabricated content in AI literature search output
links.effect: Generated output contained no hallucinations, though article selection quality and case-specific interpretation fell short of experienced researchers or physicians.
links.quote: While the generated output contained no hallucinations (a problem often seen with other large language models), the quality of the selected articles and their interpretation in the context of the specific case fell short of that achieved by experienced researchers or physicians.

screen.reason: Evaluates a ChatGPT-based search/analysis tool (Consensus) on a clinical case vignette of cerebral adrenoleukodystrophy comparing its performance to experienced physicians/researchers.
